parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.description:
Returns counts of all daily logs arranged by type, given the current user permissions. Read Only/Standard users will
see only counts of approved logs, Collaborator users will see only counts of logs created by themselves, Admins
can use filter options to see all logs, or only a specific approval status (defaulting to approved).

See [Working with Daily Logs](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/daily-logs) for information on filtering the response using the log\_date, start\_date, and end\_date parameters. Note that if none of the date parameters are provided in the call, only logs from the current date are returned.

parameters.name: log_date
parameters.description: Date of specific logs desired. Example formats YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date of specific logs desired. Use together with end_date to specify a date range. Example formats YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date of specific logs desired. Use together with start_date to specify a date range. Example formats YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY

parameters.name: filters[created_by_id]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) created by the specified User IDs.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

items.description: Meta data about a daily log module

module_name.description: The name of the log type

count.description: The number of logs that match the current date and permissions filters for this module

position.description: The position this module is shown at, on the web

403.description: User does not have right permissions

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.1/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/daily_logs/counts?log_date=SOME_STRING_VALUE&start_date=SOME_STRING_VALUE&end_date=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bstatus%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bcreated_by_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bdaily_log_segment_id%5D=123456")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
